Cautiously positive: the Fed highlights strengthening activity and employment while keeping rates at the lower bound and initiating a gradual taper, a balance consistent with inflation-forecast–targeting frameworks that stress anchoring expectations while allowing temporary overshoots (Svensson and Woodford). At the same time, Taylor-principle considerations (Clarida and co-authors) imply accommodation must diminish if inflation proves persistent. Given evidence that QE mainly operates via term-premium and signaling channels with mixed real effects and that tightening can slow real activity, taper plus continued forward guidance is only mildly restrictive, but risks are acknowledged. Net tone: modestly constructive with clear risk management.
